messages.content:
Perfect, here is a quick scene snippet featuring your cast dynamic in the corner of the Arvo Bean. The energy spikes as a clumsy character drops a tray, but a seriously anxious friend quickly pivots to a chaotic philosophical monologue that only two of the three "funny/intellectual" friends can follow while the oldest one calmly orders a melon martini.

"This is exactly why I hate the color of the armrests," Marcus says, wiping coffee off his shirt as a crash echoes nearby.
"Exactly," Sam drones, staring intently at a spoon spinning on the table. "It represents the friction between our individual consciousnesses vs the collective loup-loup of the consumerist experience."
Jessica just gasps-laughing while Mike dramatically slides off his chair to join their absurd monologue, leaving the more serious outfit to fetch a napkin for the chaos.
